subject: Post-call recap: Private/VPC deployment & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acmehealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Private/VPC deployment & next steps

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have the same plan and next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Pain points / drivers you shared:
- Data residency: production inference and logs must remain inside AcmeHealth US-only VPC and not cross regions.
- Regulatory: some hospital clusters are air-gapped / no direct internet egress for compute — updates only during maintenance windows.
- Security: customer-managed KMS/HSM requirement for key material; strong audit logging and retention controls.
- Networking constraints: no outbound connections from compute that reach public internet; egress must go through customer-controlled NAT/gateway; strict inbound rules only from your Bastion/Load Balancer.

Goals for pilot:
- Deploy Redwood Private in your AWS VPC (gov-cloud-ish setup) for two inference models (NLP retrieval + summarization).
- Target throughput: ~20 qps sustained; P95 latency goal <= 300ms for typical requests.
- Data retention: inference logs retained 30 days, with audit exports for compliance.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
1) Schedule technical deep-dive (network/security + infra) to validate egress/ingress patterns and maintenance cadence — owner: Marissa / Rishi; propose next-week times.
2) Share a lightweight network checklist + example network diagram — owner: Redwood (Rishi) — ETA: 48 hours.
3) Provide SOC2 and architecture docs for security review — owner: Marissa — ETA: 48 hours.
4) Procurement checklist & preliminary SOW / cost estimate for Private deployment — owner: Marissa — ETA: 3 business days.

Attachments: redwood-private-overview.pdf (high-level architecture & options).

If that aligns, I’ll lock in proposed times for the deep-dive and get Rishi and Neha scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Private/VPC deployment & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. That matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- Pilot scope confirmed: two models as discussed, running inside our US VPC.
- Air-gap note: for the hospital sites that are fully air-gapped, we will need the ability to do offline model updates via signed packages. No persistent outbound connections from those enclaves.
- Key management: we require HSM-backed keys; Redwood must be able to integrate with our KMS (AWS CloudHSM) and we need documentation on key rotation and access controls.
- Storage: no shared storage outside the VPC. All model artifacts and logs must reside in AcmeHealth-controlled buckets/subnets.

Procurement: Please send a concise procurement checklist (network ports, ACLs, contact for Certs/NAT configuration) and preliminary commercial terms. Priya (cc’d) will coordinate procurement/legal review.

Proposed times for deep-dive: Wed 18 Mar 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 19 Mar 14:00–15:00 PT. We prefer Wed if possible.

Thanks —
Sanjay Rao
Director, Infrastructure Security | AcmeHealth
Sanjay.Rao@acmehealth.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Private/VPC deployment & next steps

Thanks Sanjay — appreciate the clarifications. A few technical points / questions ahead of the deep-dive so we can be prepared:

1) Egress model: for the non-air-gapped clusters, we support routing egress through customer NAT or an outbound proxy. For strictly air-gapped sites, we can do signed model-package deployment via S3-import jobs initiated by your ops team. Can you confirm which application clusters are fully air-gapped vs. VPC-with-egress?

2) KMS/HSM: we integrate with AWS KMS & CloudHSM for key wrapping. Need contact for your KMS admin to validate access patterns and whether cross-account roles are allowed.

3) Certificate rotation & mTLS: we support mTLS between control plane and the private runtime; do you require on-prem certificate rotation policies enforced by your PKI?

4) Network diagram: attached a sample network diagram showing required subnets, port ranges, and recommended NAT/peerings. This is a starting point — we’ll walk through it in the deep-dive.

Attachments: network_diagram.pdf (sample layout, ports, and bastion patterns).

Available for Wed 18 Mar 10:00–11:00 PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include our Security SME.

— Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
